meta.note: raw data read-only; ghost zones/metric see oct12_nav_common.ghost_metrics

ppl_explanation.recon_assumes: split_mode2: 153 views per volume = 9 + 16 x 9 (volume train of ETL+1, then 16 shots of 8 imaging echoes + 1 unencoded navigator echo)
ppl_explanation.data_contain: 119 views per volume = 7 + 16 x 7, written contiguously (4 x 119 = 476 views, rest of the 4 x 153 file zero)
ppl_explanation.ppl_v183_line_1412: crusher_etl = views_per_seg+(nav_on==2);   (views_per_seg already reduced to 8 by the nav_on==2 block at line 586)
ppl_explanation.ppl_arithmetic: PPL relational operators evaluate to -1 for TRUE (EVO PPL manual, "== EQUALS Operator"; the vendor idiom notDummy = -(disacq_cnt >= no_disacq) at line 4204 relies on it) -> crusher_etl = 8 + (-1) = 7
ppl_explanation.consequence: 7 echoes per train: the 8th imaging echo and per-shot navigator echo are never played; the volume navigator also has 7 echoes, giving 17 shots × 7 = 119 views per volume. The sparse 128-row grid leaves 16 missing lines zero-filled. Its line ordering equals pe_rows(112,7,1) after subtracting a common 8-row offset, but the compact 112-row FFT has a different pixel spacing and needs explicit physical rescaling.
ppl_explanation.v1912: uses v1912_echoes = views_per_seg; if (nav_on==2) v1912_echoes = v1912_echoes+1 (line 2591-2592) and echo_cnt < v1912_echoes (line 4206) -> 9 echoes; R matches the recon contract
ppl_explanation.v182: the same line 1402 exists in v1.82 (and v1.83 PPL inherits it): any v1.82/v1.83 nav_on=2 scan would behave like N
ppl_explanation.fix_suggestion: crusher_etl = views_per_seg; if (nav_on==2) crusher_etl = crusher_etl+1;   (and make the python event model use PPL boolean semantics)
ppl_explanation.pe_step: gp_inc = scale(templ1,2,no_views) at line 1620 runs after the nav_on==2 reduction (no_views 153 -> 136) while the console computed gp_init_var=-1125 for NO_VIEWS=153 (gp_init_var / NO_VIEWS = -7.353 in every 10-12 scan) -> phase-encode step 1.125x the nav_on=1 value in both N and R (PE FOV 31.1 mm instead of 35 mm; R pixel 0.243 mm vs 0.273 mm along PE; fitted row scale R/Q 0.89 vs theory 0.889). Fix: divide by the embedded NO_VIEWS (153) or scale gp_init_var by 136/153.
ppl_explanation.scrambling: the recon takes 9-view blocks from a 7-view stream: every shot is mis-assigned (ky rows wrong, the navigator train and shot starts walk through the data), giving a scrambled k-space and horizontal banding
ppl_explanation.reorder: Per volume: split the flat raw stream into 119 views; views 0–6 are the volume navigator. Reshape the remaining 112 samples to 16 × 7 and place them at pe_rows(128,8,1).reshape(16,8)[:,:7], then zero-fill to 128 × 128 before FFT. This has the same acquisition order as pe_rows(112,7,1) up to a +8-row origin, while retaining scanner-grid coordinates. PE step is 1.125×, giving 31.1-mm phase FOV.
ppl_explanation.compact_representation_equivalence: Actual sparse rows minus 8 equal pe_rows(112,7,1) exactly; both represent the same 112 acquired line values in acquisition order, but their output grid and implied pixel spacing differ.

section3_ghosting.definition: ghost_primary = (mean |I| in the phase-encode zone - mean |I| in the readout control zone) / mean |I| of the volume object; PE zone = columns spanning the object, outside the dilated object (4 % of rows); RO zone = rows spanning the object, outside the dilated object. ex vivo b>=3000: object = the volume's own mask (brain) so the PBS-filled tube interior counts as zone; all other cases: object = own mask U b10 mask (outside the whole tube / head). reliable = object SNR >= 4 and >= 150 object pixels.

section2_per_shot_navigator.N_note: scan N has no per-shot navigator echo (7 echoes per shot, none unencoded), so no per-shot correction is possible
